injuries.name: Albert Johansson
injuries.note: Johansson has missed the last five games due to his unspecified injury, so his placement on injured reserve is procedural, and he'll be eligible to be activated at any point. It's not yet clear when the 25-year-old will be able to return to action.

injuries.name: Mason Appleton
injuries.note: Appleton has been considered week-to-week since landing on injured reserve in early October, and he'll require more time on the shelf despite practicing in a non-contact sweater Friday. The 30-year-old will presumably have opportunities to increase his activity level at practice in the near future before presumably being considered to return to game action around mid-November.

injuries.name: Marco Kasper
injuries.note: Kasper skated in a non-contact jersey during Friday's practice session, but he isn't expected to return to game action for over a week as he continues to recover from an upper-body injury. The 22-year-old has been on injured reserve since Oct. 6 and has been considered week-to-week since then, but it appears as though he'll be in the mix to return around mid-November.

injuries.name: Simon Edvinsson
injuries.note: Edvinsson is continuing to hold out for a new contract as a restricted free agent, with no clear end in sight. It's possible a trade materializes at some point, though he would still need to agree to terms on a new contract with a different NHL club. Last season, Edvinsson recorded nine goals and 16 assists in 72 regular-season contests.

injuries.name: Yanni Gourde
injuries.note: Tampa Bay's road trip includes stops in Minnesota, Winnipeg, Buffalo and Columbus on Saturday, Sunday, Wednesday and Thursday, respectively. Gourde hasn't played yet this campaign due to the injury. He had nine goals and 28 points in 82 regular-season appearances with Tampa Bay in 2025-26. Gourde will probably serve in a middle-six role once he's healthy.

injuries.name: Mason Appleton
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Detroit Red Wings said on Friday (Oct. 30) that Appleton is still 10 days to two weeks away from returning to game action, per Ansar Khan of MLive.com.

injuries.name: Albert Johansson
injuries.note: Undisclosed: Johansson will miss at least three more games, per Ansar Khan of MLive.com.

injuries.name: Marco Kasper
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Detroit Red Wings said on Friday (Oct. 30) that Kasper is still 10 days to two weeks away from returning to game action, per Ansar Khan of MLive.com.

injuries.name: Zemgus Girgensons
injuries.note: Lower-Body: Girgensons is OUT for Tuesday's (Nov. 3) game versus the Red Wings, per Lightning reporter Gabby Shirley.

injuries.note: Hip: The Tampa Bay Lightning placed F Yanni Gourde on injured reserve.
